description:
Helping Pets Thrive


Partner with VetCBD Hemp and share veterinarian-formulated pet wellness products that your audience can feel confident about. With trusted quality standards, real veterinary support, and competitive commissions, our affiliate program makes it easy to earn while helping pets live happier, more comfortable lives.

About our brand and products:
VetCBD Hemp creates veterinarian-founded and formulated hemp wellness products for pets, including CBD tinctures, calming chews, mobility chews, advanced tinctures, and equine tinctures. Our mission is to help animals thrive by offering premium, plant-based products designed to support everyday pet wellness. VetCBD Hemp products are made with hemp containing less than 0.3% THC. (VetCBD)

What makes us different:
VetCBD Hemp is veterinarian founded and formulated, triple lab-tested for safety and accuracy, NASC certified for quality, and backed by real veterinary support. We also offer free product consultations with veterinary professionals to help pet parents feel confident choosing the right product for their animal’s routine. (VetCBD)

How affiliates can earn:
Affiliates earn commissions when customers purchase through their unique referral link or code. Affiliates can offer their audience 10% off at checkout while earning 10% commission (*Special commission on Equine Formulation). Approved affiliates receive access to a dashboard where they can track clicks, sales, and commissions in real time. Payouts are made 35–45 days after purchase via PayPal once the minimum payout threshold is met. (VetCBD)

How to promote us:
Share your unique VetCBD Hemp referral link or discount code with your audience through social media, email newsletters, blogs, product reviews, pet wellness content, educational posts, videos, giveaways, and other approved promotional channels. The best content is authentic, pet-focused, and centered on wellness, quality ingredients, responsible CBD education, and the bond between pets and their people.

Other information:
There is no upfront cost to join the affiliate program. Affiliates should use compliant language and avoid saying that VetCBD Hemp products diagnose, treat, cure, or prevent any disease. Please include proper affiliate disclosures when sharing links or codes, and follow all brand guidelines when creating content. Due to state laws, VetCBD Hemp may be unable to ship some or all products to certain states, and all product statements should remain consistent with the FDA disclosure on the website. (VetCBD)
